name: OpenGL 3D Vision Wrapper (Helifax)
description: Wraps system opengl32.dll for specific OpenGL games and creates a hidden DirectX device (D3D9, per the Helifax-era context — unverified from binaries alone) that NVAPI's 3D Vision Automatic Mode targets. Result: OpenGL games render stereoscopic 3D output via NVIDIA's 3D Vision Automatic Mode path. Different mechanism from wiz3D OpenGL — wiz3D handles OpenGL quad-buffer-stereo games via its own injection, while this wrapper is for OpenGL games that don't have native QBS and need 3D Vision Automatic Mode as the bridge. Per-game shader-injection-point config in 3DVisionWrapper.ini.
license: tbd — source not currently in lib/, only binaries + per-game fixes

platform.note: Requires NVIDIA 3D Vision Automatic Mode, which means an old NVIDIA driver (typically 417.xx or earlier) and a 3D Vision-certified monitor.

notes: Game-specific fixes ship with their own pre-configured 3DVisionWrapper.ini + injection points (see lib/OGL-3DVision-Wrapper/Fixes/{Minecraft,Rage,Riddick,X-Plane10}/). wiz3D OpenGL is the preferred modern path for OpenGL games where the game already has native QBS; this wrapper covers the case where it doesn't.
